Home.exploreDescription: Nnyonnyola alipooti mu bifo, ebizibu, ennimi n'ebiseera okutegeera ebibaawo ku ttaka.
Home.faq1Answer: Watchtower kintu eky'okuwandiika alipooti mu nnimi nyingi era eky'okuzuula amawulire awamu, ekiyamba abantu okuwaayo alipooti ku nsonga z'obwannakyewa n'okutyoboola ddembe mu nnimi ze ze bayogera. Alipooti ze ziwandiika zisobola okusengebwa, okulinyibwa mu maapu n'okwekenenyezebwa okulaba engeri eziriwo n'okuyamba okutuusawo ebintu.
Home.faq2Answer: Osobola okuwaayo alipooti ku nsonga ng'okutyoboola ddembe, emitawaana egy'obulamu n'ebirala eby'ekifo ebiri mu kitundu kyo: kiki konna ekirala abantu kye baba basaanidde okumanya oba eky'andiyambye okwongera okumanya ebintu bya kukola.
Home.faq2Question: Kiki kye nnyinza okuwaayo alipooti ku Watchtower?
Home.faq3Answer: Yee. Osobola okuwaayo alipooti ng'ogeza oba ng'owandiika mu lulimi lw'olusobola obulungi, era Watchtower ekyamba okukyusa ebigambo mu kuwandiika, okuvuunula mu nnimi endala n'okusengeka alipooti yo okusobola okutegeerekeka mu nnimi zonna.
Home.faq3Question: Nnyinza okuwandiika alipooti mu lulimi lwange?
Home.faq4Answer: Yee. Obutamanyiddwa kye kintu ekikuddira mu bya bulijjo, si ekintu eky'enjawulo: totonzanga kwagala erinnya lyo oba amawulire g'okumanya ggwe wabanga owaayo alipooti.
Home.faq5Answer: Buli alipooti ennyonnyolwa era ekenenyezebwa, esengebwa mu maapu awamu ne zzirala okulaba engeri eziriwo, era ewebwa abantu, ebibiina n'ebitongole ebisobola okutuusawo ekintu ku nsonga.
Home.faq5Question: Kiki ekituukirira nga mmaze okuwaayo alipooti?
Home.faqsDescription: Manyira ebisinga ku kuwandiika alipooti, ku nnimi, ku kukuumibwa kw'amawulire n'engeri Watchtower gy'eyamba okufuna amawulire amagasa ku bantu awamu.
Home.heroDescription: Watchtower ekkiriza abantu okuwaayo alipooti ku nsonga z'ekitundu n'okutyoboola kwa ddembe mu nnimi zaabwe, buli omu n'asobola okwetaba mu bulamu bw'abannansi n'okuvunaanyizibwa mu lwatu.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Okuva ku alipooti emu okutuuka ku nkyukakyuka ey'omu nkola yonna, bwe kityo WatchTower gy'esobozesa ebibiina okuwulirwa n'okuleeta enkyukakyuka ey'amakulu.
Home.insightsDescription: Tunuulira ensonga ez'enjawulo ku kuwandiika alipooti kw'obwannakyewa, okwetaba mu nfuga z'ensi, tekinologiya ya nnimi nyingi n'engeri amawulire amalungi gy'asobola okuyamba okutuukiriza ebintu ebigasa.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Lwaki amaloboozi ag'obwannakyewa ga nkizo mu kutegeera bye biriwo mu nsi
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Okumenyamu ekiziyizo kya lulimi mu kuwandiika ebibuusa awamu
Home.insightsFallback3Title: Okuva ku alipooti eziwandiikibwa omuntu omu okutuuka ku ngeri ezikolera wamu
Home.insightsHeading: Ebirowoozo, emboozi n'okutegeera okuva ku kifo.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: Watchtower ekyusa ebigambo mu kuwandiika, ekyuunula mu nnimi endala era esengeka alipooti, n'olwekyo amawulire gategeerekeka, wadde ly'ali lulimi olukozesebwa mu kuteesa alipooti.
Home.step1Description: Tuwaayo tekinologiya esobozesa abantu n'ebibiina okuwaayo alipooti ku nsonga z'ekibiina oba okutyoboola kwa ddembe okuva ku ssimu yaabwe oba kompyuta mu lulimi lwe boogera.
Home.step2Description: Tukola era tukakasa buli alipooti, nga tussa ebikwata ku mmapu era tuzuula enkola ezaali zitalabika. Amawulire agatali gakolebwako gafuuka amagezi amanyi era amateekeddwa nga gategeeza olugero olusingako.
Home.step3Description: Ebibiina, ebitongole n'amasomero bikozesa amagezi gano okuzimba emisango, okuvunaanyiza abavunaanyizibwa, era okusindika enkyukakyuka ey'amakulu, ng'ekakasibwa obukakafu obw'amazima okuva ku ttaka.
Home.impactDescription: Zuula engeri ebibiina gye biwulirwa, gye bikwata ku nsalawo era gye biletawo enkyukakyuka.
About.ctaDescription: Waayo alipooti ku nsonga z'ekitundu mu lulimi lwo. Tewali akawunti keetaagisa, tewali bikwata ku ndaba byetaagisa.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Tewali profayiro kuzimba wadde okulondoola. Ojja, owaayo, ogenda. Tewali kikugatta ku alipooti yo.
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Yee. WatchTower tekuuma bikwata ku sessioni oba cookies ezikwatagana n'alipooti yo. Okuwaayo alipooti okuva ku kyuma ekigabaganyizibwa tekukuteeka mu kabi.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Nsobola okuwaayo alipooti okuva ku kyuma ekigabaganyizibwa oba eky'olwatu?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Alipooti zonna zikuumibwa okuva ku kaseera k'ozitumira. Alipooti yo tesobola kukwatibwa oba okuzuulwa okudda gy'oli mu kiseera ky'okutambula.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Alipooti yange esobola okuzuulwa okudda gye ndi?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Toteekwa kuwaayo linnya lyo, namba ya ssimu, oba bikwata ku ndaba yonna okuwaayo alipooti. Obutayatula lye linnya lya bulijjo, si njawulo.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Endaba yange ekuumibwa nga mpaayo alipooti?
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Alipooti zikebererwa bakulembeze ba WatchTower abakakasiddwa bokka. Alipooti yo tegabanyizibwa mu lwatu n'ekintu kyonna ekiraga endaba.
About.heroDescription: WatchTower lubu lwa magezi g'abannansi olusinziira ku bibiina olukozesa AI n'ebikozesebwa ku nnimi z'ekitundu okusobozesa abantu okuwaayo alipooti ku bintu ebibaddewo, obulabe n'okutyoboola kwa ddembe mu nnimi zaabwe ku bwabwe, era lufuula alipooti zino okuba amagezi agakozesebwa mu kuvunaanyizibwa n'okuddamu.
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower ezimbiddwa okwetoloola ennimi abantu ze bakozesa ddala. Olulimi lulabika mu kuwaayo alipooti kwonna, ne kiyamba abantu okwogera mu ngeri ey’obulijjo nga n’amawulire gategeerekeka mu nnimi ez’enjawulo.
About.objectiveDescription: Okukakasa nti buli muntu alina obuyinza okuwaayo alipooti ku nsonga z'ekitundu mu lulimi lw'ayogera, obutabaawo ddoboozi lyonna eritawulirwa era buli omu n'asobola okwetaba mu kuvunaanyiza abavunaanyizibwa.
About.safetyDescription: Tumanyi nti okwogera kiyinza okuleeta akabi. Bw'atyo WatchTower gye yazimbibwa okukukuuma.
Security.metaDescription: Engeri gy'owaayo alipooti ku bunafu bw'obukuumi eri ekibiina kya AmplifiedAccess.
Security.heroDescription: Engeri gye tukwata alipooti ez'obunafu n'okwewaayo kwaffe eri okubikkula okw'obuvunaanyizibwa.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess ekwata obukuumi bwa WatchTower nga kikulu. Twagala okwagala kw'abanoonyereza ku bukuumi n'abo ab'omu kibiina abatuyamba okukuuma olubu nga lwa bukuumi eri buli muntu.
Security.reportingWarning: Tobaayo bunafu bw'obukuumi mu bibuuzo bya GitHub eby'olwatu.
Security.reportingInstruction: Mu kifo ky'ekyo, wabikirire ekibiina kyaffe butereevu nga oyisa email:
Security.reportingResponseTime: Olina okufuna eddobozi mu essaawa 48. Bw'otoliggya, wabikirira nate nga oyisa email okukakasa nti twafuna obubaka bwo obw'olubereberye.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: Okutuyamba okwekenneenya alipooti yo mangu, tosaba oyingize ebiri wammanga nga bwe kisoboka:
Security.includeItem1: Ekika ky'ekizibu (nga SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, n'ebirala)
Security.includeItem3: Ekifo ky'ekikoodi ekikoseddwa (branch, commit hash, oba URL butereevu)
Security.includeItem4: Enteekateeka yonna ey'enjawulo eyetaagisa okuddamu ekizibu
Security.includeItem5: Ebiragiro ebigenda ku ntambula okuddamu ekizibu
Security.includeItem6: Obukakafu bw'endowooza oba exploit code, bwe kisoboka
Security.includeItem7: Ekikosa ky'ekizibu, nga kw'otadde n'engeri omunyazi gy'ayinza okukikozesaamu
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess egoberera omusingi gwa <link>Okubikkula okw'Obunafu okw'entegeka</link>. Tusaba otuwe ekiseera ekimala okwekenneenya n'okumalawo ekizibu ekiwaddwako alipooti nga tonnabikkula mu lwatu.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: Tujja kukumanya enkulaakulana yaffe mu kwekenneenya kwonna era tukuwe ettendo ku by'ozudde bw'oba oyagala.
Security.languageText: Twagala empuliziganya zonna ez'obukuumi zibeere mu Lungereza.
CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: Emitindo gy'ekibiina kya AmplifiedAccess n'amateeka g'empisa eri abawaayo n'abetaba.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Okwewaayo kwaffe eri ekibiina ekiggule, ekyaniriza era ekitalimu kuyigganya eri buli muntu.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: Nga bammemba, abawaayo, n'abakulembeze b'ekibiina kya AmplifiedAccess twesuubiza okufuula okwetaba mu kibiina kyaffe okuba obumanyirivu obutalimu kuyigganya eri buli muntu, ka aba w'emyaka emeka, obunene bw'omubiri, obulema obulabika oba obutalabika, ekika, engeri z'obuzaale, endaba n'okweraga kw'obuzaale, omulembe gw'obumanyirivu, okusoma, embeera y'ebyenfuna n'eby'obulamu, ensi gye yava, endabika ya bulijjo, ekika, ekika ky'obuwangwa, langi, eddiini, oba endaba n'obuzaale bw'obukazi n'obusajja.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: Twesuubiza okukola n'okukolagana mu ngeri eyongera ku kibiina ekiggule, ekyaniriza, eky'enjawulo, ekitwalirawo era ekirungi.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Ebyokulabirako by'empisa eziyamba embeera ennungi mulimu:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Okulaga okusaasira n'ekisa eri abantu abalala
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive2: Okussaamu ekitiibwa endowooza, endabika, n'obumanyirivu obw'enjawulo
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Okuwaayo n'okukkiriza mu bwegendereza ebiwandiiko ebiyamba
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Okukkiriza obuvunaanyizibwa n'okusaba ekisonyiwo eri abo abakoseddwa ensobi zaffe, era okuyiga okuva mu bumanyirivu
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Okusimbawo amaaso ku ekyo ekisinga obulungi si eri ffe nga bantu bokka, wabula eri ekibiina kyonna
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: Okukozesa olulimi oba ebifaananyi eby'obukazi n'obusajja, n'okussaayo omwoyo oba okusembera okw'obukazi n'obusajja okwa buli ngeri
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Okunyiiza, ebiwandiiko eby'okuvuma oba eby'okunyooma, n'okulumba kwa bulijjo oba okwa bufuzi
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Okusaasaanya amawulire g'ekyama ag'abalala, nga endagiriro y'omubiri oba eya email, awatali lukusa lw'olwatu
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Empisa endala yonna eyinza okulowoozebwa nti si nnungi mu mbeera ey'obukugu
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitie: Abakulembeze b'ekibiina mu AmplifiedAccess balina obuvunaanyizibwa okunnyonnyola n'okutuukiriza emitindo gyaffe egy'empisa ekkirizibwa era bagenda kukola ekikolwa eky'obwenkanya era ekituufu okuddamu empisa yonna gye balaba nga si nnungi, ey'okutiisa, ey'okunyiiza, oba ey'okulumya.

Abakulembeze b'ekibiina balina obuyinza n'obuvunaanyizibwa okuggyawo, okukyusa, oba okugaana ebiwandiiko, commits, kkoodi, enkyukakyuka za wiki, ebibuuzo, n'ebirala ebiweebwayo ebitagenderera ku Mateeka gano ag'Empisa, era balitegeeza ensonga z'okusalawo mu kulondoola nga kyetaagisa.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: Amateeka gano ag'Empisa gakwatibwako mu bifo byonna eby'ekibiina, era gakwatibwako n'omuntu bw'abeera akiikirira mu bwetegefu ekibiina kya AmplifiedAccess mu bifo eby'olwatu. Ebyokulabirako by'okukiikirira ekibiina kyaffe mulimu okukozesa endagiriro ya email ey'obwetegefu, okuwandiika nga oyita ku akawunti y'empuliziganya z'olwatu, oba okukola ng'omukiikirira eyalondebwa mu mukolo ogw'oku yintaneeti oba ogutali gwa yintaneeti.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Ebibaddewo eby'empisa embi, okuyigganya, oba endala etakkirizibwa bisobola okubikkulirwa ekibiina kya AmplifiedAccess ku:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: Byonna ebyemulugunya bijja kwekenneenyezebwa era n'okwekenneenyezebwa mu bwangu era mu bwenkanya. Abakulembeze bonna ab'ekibiina balina obuvunaanyizibwa okussaamu ekitiibwa ekyama n'obukuumi bw'omuntu awaayo alipooti ku kintu kyonna.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Abakulembeze b'ekibiina bajja kugoberera ebiragiro bino mu kusalawo ebiva mu kikolwa kyonna kye balowooza nti kimenya Amateeka gano ag'Empisa:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Okukozesa olulimi olutali lulungi oba empisa endala eziraba nti tezisaanira mu kibiina oba tezaanirizibwa.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: Okulabula okw'ekyama okuwandiike okuva mu bakulembeze b'ekibiina, nga kunnyonnyola obulungi ku bikwata ku kumenya n'okunnyonnyola ensonga lwaki empisa yali mbi. Ekisonyiwo eky'olwatu kiyinza okusabibwa.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: Okumenya nga kuyita mu kikolwa kimu oba enkola y'ebikolwa.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: Okulabula okuliko ebiva mu mpisa ezeeyongera. Tewali kukolagana n'abo abaali mu nsonga, nga kw'otadde okukolagana okutasabiddwa n'abo abatuukiriza Amateeka g'Empisa, mu kiseera ekigere. Okumenya ebigambo bino kiyinza okuvaamu okugaanibwa okumala akaseera oba emirembe gyonna.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: Okumenya okw'amaanyi emitindo gy'ekibiina, nga kw'otadde empisa embi eyeeyongera.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceTex: Okugaanibwa okumala akaseera okukolagana kwonna oba empuliziganya y'olwatu n'ekibiina okumala ekiseera ekigere. Tewali kukolagana kw'olwatu oba ekyama n'abo abaali mu nsonga okukkirizibwa mu kiseera kino. Okumenya ebigambo bino kiyinza okuvaamu okugaanibwa emirembe gyonna.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Okulaga enkola y'okumenya emitindo gy'ekibiina, nga kw'otadde empisa embi eyeeyongera, okuyigganya kw'omuntu, oba okulumba oba okunyooma ebibinja by'abantu.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceTex: Okugaanibwa emirembe gyonna okukolagana kwonna okw'olwatu munda mu kibiina.
CodeOfConduct.attributionText: Amateeka gano ag'Empisa gaggibwa mu <covenantLink>Contributor Covenant</covenantLink>, ekitundu 2.1, ekisangibwa ku <versionLink>contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct</versionLink>.

About.step1Description: Waayo alipooti ku nsonga ng’owandiika oba ng’oyogera, mu lulimi lw’owulira bulungi. Yongerako ebikwata ku nsonga, ekifo n’obujulizi bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
About.step2Description: WatchTower etegeka alipooti okusinziira ku bifo, ennimi n’ensonga, ne kiyamba okutegeera obulungi ebikolwa ebikwatagana n’ebyo ebiddiŋŋana.
About.step3Description: Kozesa alipooti ezikwatagana n’obujulizi bw’ebitundu okuwagira okunoonyereza, obuvunaanyizibwa, okulwanirira eddembe n’okusalawo okw’amagezi.
About.audienceCommunitiesDescription: Waayo alipooti ku nsonga n’ebyo by’oyiseemu mu kitundu kyo, mu lulimi lw’owulira bulungi.
About.audienceOrganisationsDescription: Funa era wekkenneenye alipooti, ddukanya okussa era ozuule enkola ezeddiŋŋana mu bitundu.
About.audienceEvidenceDescription: Abanoonyereza, bannamawulire n’ebibiina ebikola ku nsonga z’abantu bonna basobola okunoonyereza ku alipooti, ebifo n’enkyukakyuka okutegeera obulungi abantu kye bayitamu.
About.heroIntro: WatchTower etandikira ku kirowoozo ekyangu: okwanguyiza abantu okuwaayo alipooti ku bibaddewo, n’oluvannyuma okufuula alipooti ezo ez’omugaso okusingawo nga tetwerabidde bantu bazaawaddeyo.
